name: Playful Cartoon
audience: Broad age range; immediate recognition for new players.
camera: Third-person with readable silhouettes at medium distance.
identity: Stacked pebble-like forms and offset stripes establish a fresh toy-world language.

palette.rule: Reserve saturated accents for actionable items; pair semantic hues with shape and icon cues.

geometry: Rounded block primitives, oversize handles and exaggerated but distinct silhouettes; no micro-detail at play distance.

materials.surfaces: Mostly matte painted wood, rubber and soft ceramic.
materials.texture_rule: Use broad color fields and sparse handmade marks rather than noisy photo detail.
materials.tiling_rule: Only repeat on large ground or wall areas; verify joins and motif repetition in 3x3.

lighting: Bright soft key, mild ambient fill and controlled shadow contrast.
effects: Brief squash-like particles for feedback; avoid full-screen persistent bloom.
ui: Large rounded controls, text labels with icons, generous mobile touch targets.
audio: Short pitched wooden taps and airy percussive motifs; distinct reward and danger signatures.

budgets.reuse_rule: Reuse a compact material atlas and recolor modular prop families.

originality: Invent silhouettes, symbols and characters for this game; exclude copied franchise shapes, logos and familiar Roblox-game identities.
